resources.string: 3. Review prompts and feedback

By default: wait 1 day, complete at least 1 key action, and allow 30 days between requests. The test action records a simulated completion and obeys this policy. Play may not show a card. Flow completion or opening a store or email app does not confirm a submitted review or message.
